source: Project: Self v2.3 via build spec v1.1, Appendices C, C.1, E, F, O

rows.title: DSA W1: Arrays & Hashing
rows.description: Contains Duplicate, Valid Anagram, Two Sum, Group Anagrams, Top K Frequent, Product Except Self, Valid Sudoku, Longest Consecutive.
rows.outputRequired: Create repo + mistake log.
rows.fallback: Do not force all 8 problems if setup takes time.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W1
rows.description: Trade-offs in data systems architecture. Begin a note on operational vs analytical systems and single-node vs distributed design.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W2: Two Pointers
rows.description: Valid Palindrome, Two Sum II, 3Sum, Container With Most Water, Trapping Rain Water.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W2
rows.description: Defining nonfunctional requirements: latency percentiles, reliability, scalability, maintainability, operability.
rows.outputRequired: Explain what the system must do and how success is measured. Confirm your DDIA edition.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W3: Stacks
rows.description: Min Stack, Evaluate RPN, Generate Parentheses, Daily Temperatures, Car Fleet, Largest Rectangle; begin Binary Search.
rows.outputRequired: Explain a monotonic stack.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W3
rows.description: Data models and query languages: relational/document models, graphs, normalization, CQRS/event sourcing concepts.
rows.outputRequired: Draw the domain data model.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W4: Binary Search
rows.description: Binary Search, Search 2D Matrix, Koko, Rotated Array, Time Based KV, Median of Two Sorted Arrays.
rows.outputRequired: Write binary-search-on-answer template.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W4
rows.description: Storage and retrieval: B-trees, LSM-trees, indexes, OLTP/analytics, vector embeddings.
rows.outputRequired: Explain index choice.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W5: Sliding Window
rows.description: Best Time to Buy/Sell Stock, Longest Substring, Longest Repeating Character Replacement, Permutation in String, Min Window.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W5
rows.description: Encoding and evolution: JSON/Avro/Protobuf, schemas, compatible dataflows.
rows.outputRequired: Write a schema-evolution note.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: React: components, props, state
rows.outputRequired: Make one functional component.

rows.title: DSA W6: Linked List I
rows.description: Reverse, Merge Two Sorted, Reorder, Remove Nth, Linked List Cycle, Add Two Numbers.
rows.outputRequired: Pointer manipulation drills.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W6
rows.description: Replication: leaders/followers, lag, failover, multi-leader trade-offs.
rows.outputRequired: Explain read-after-write and replication lag.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W7: Linked List II
rows.description: Copy List with Random Pointer, Find Duplicate, LRU Cache, Merge K Sorted, Reverse Nodes in K-Group.
rows.outputRequired: Build LRU cache.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W7
rows.description: Sharding / partitioning: partition keys, skew, rebalancing, routing.
rows.outputRequired: Explain why hot partitions happen.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W8: Trees I
rows.description: Invert, Max Depth, Diameter, Balanced, Same Tree, Subtree, LCA of BST.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W8
rows.description: Transactions: isolation anomalies, serializability, write skew, distributed transactions.
rows.outputRequired: Slow down here; explain lost updates and transaction boundaries.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: React: list/detail + create/edit form calling the API
rows.outputRequired: Functional state and error handling matter more than styling.

rows.title: DSA W9: Trees II
rows.description: Level Order, Right Side View, Count Good Nodes, Validate BST, Kth Smallest, Serialize/Deserialize.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W9
rows.description: The trouble with distributed systems: partial failures, unreliable networks/clocks, timeouts, leases.
rows.outputRequired: Explain what happens when one dependency is slow or unavailable.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: DSA W10: Tries; Heap / Priority Queue
rows.description: Tries; Kth Largest, Top K Frequent Words, Task Scheduler, Median from Stream.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W10
rows.description: Consistency and consensus: linearizability, logical clocks, consensus.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: MEAI/MAF W1: IChatClient via DI and first small agent
rows.outputRequired: Hello-agent runs with current documented package versions.
rows.fallback: Use a mock/local provider if hosted access blocks.

rows.title: DSA W11: Heap patterns; Backtracking
rows.description: Finish heap patterns; Subsets, Combination Sum, Permutations, Generate Parentheses review.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W11
rows.description: Batch processing.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: MEAI/MAF W2: one safe function/tool call, structured output and cancellation
rows.outputRequired: One tool call with validation and tests.
rows.fallback: Do not add a multi-agent design.

rows.title: DSA W12: Backtracking
rows.description: Combination Sum II, Word Search, Palindrome Partitioning, Letter Combinations, selected weak-topic review.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W12
rows.description: Stream processing and the philosophy of streaming systems.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: MEAI/MAF: minimal RAG over a small corpus
rows.outputRequired: Retrieval baseline with citations.
rows.fallback: In-memory or local fallback if vector setup blocks progress.

rows.title: DSA W13: Cold redo
rows.description: No new topics; cold-redo 8-10 weakest problems and attempt two mediums back-to-back.
rows.outputRequired: Cold-redo 8-10 weakest problems; two mediums back-to-back.

rows.title: DDIA reading for W13
rows.description: Doing the right thing: privacy, access control, retention, auditability. Finish chapter notes.
rows.outputRequired: Phase 1 retrospective; extend only missing fundamentals, not optional tools.
rows.fallback: Pacing aid only: keep reading order, adjust week boundaries to the actual page count, keep a useful note.

rows.title: Flagship design document (3-5 pages)
rows.description: Domain, API, data model, boundaries, threats and failure modes. Keep employer code and data out of the repo.

rows.title: Write five ADRs
rows.description: Use the one-page ADR template (Appendix M, G).

rows.title: Finish the small functional React app
rows.outputRequired: List/detail and a create/edit form calling your API.

rows.title: Finish the minimal AI exercise
rows.outputRequired: Hello-agent, one safe tool call, minimal RAG baseline.

rows.title: Phase 1 retrospective
rows.outputRequired: Extend only missing fundamentals, not optional tools.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.1 Foundations
rows.description: Solution layout, domain modules, PostgreSQL, migrations, tests, CI, health checks, structured logs. One API process.
rows.outputRequired: Reproducible local run.
rows.fallback: If Docker setup blocks, run API + local database first and document the environment.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.2 Core behavior
rows.description: CRUD/domain rules, validation, ProblemDetails, pagination, authorization, integration tests. Add one worker for an identified async task.
rows.outputRequired: A vertical slice from request to database with tests.
rows.fallback: No gateway or broker.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.3 Reliability/data
rows.description: Indexes/query plans, cancellation, timeouts, bounded retries only where safe, traces and failure tests.
rows.outputRequired: One measured before/after improvement.
rows.fallback: Add cache only for a proven hot path.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.4 AI layer
rows.description: Document ingestion, metadata, chunking, retrieval baseline, citations and one safe read-only tool.
rows.outputRequired: Start with 20-50 documents and known questions.
rows.fallback: Skip reranking until the baseline shows a problem.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.5 UI/integration
rows.description: Minimal React UI or API demo; auth/error/loading states. Python starts as a small HTTP evaluation client.
rows.outputRequired: Freeze styling.
rows.fallback: No Python sidecar or gRPC service.

rows.title: Ask-Ops 2.6 Eval/demo
rows.description: 20-case golden set, retrieval/answer review, README, architecture diagram, demo and Canary learning notes.
rows.outputRequired: Document limitations and failures honestly.
rows.fallback: Expand only if time remains.

rows.title: Canary warm-up applications (optional learning target)
rows.description: Send suitable warm-up applications and aim for diagnostic screens if opportunities arise. Optional targets: 8-10 warm-up applications, 2-3 diagnostic screens; no count is guaranteed.
rows.outputRequired: Record funnel evidence.

rows.title: Baseline and bottlenecks
rows.description: Run k6 against real project journeys; inspect SQL plans, serialization, connection pool, worker backlog, retrieval latency. Change one variable at a time.
rows.outputRequired: Before/after RPS, p50/p95/p99, error rate, dataset, machine and test profile.

rows.title: Production-shaped deployment
rows.description: Harden Dockerfile, CI build/test/scan, secrets, health/readiness, logs/traces, reproducible deploy.
rows.outputRequired: Live URL or repeatable local deploy, pipeline run, dashboard/export and limits.

rows.title: Reliability and evaluation
rows.description: Failure injection, retry/cancellation tests, regression gate for golden set, documented operational procedure.
rows.outputRequired: CI quality/eval gate; failure runbook; eval delta.

rows.title: Case study and mocks
rows.description: Write architecture case study, record demo, do system-design and project walkthrough mocks; improve weak areas.
rows.outputRequired: Case study, updated README/resume bullets, 6-8 reviewed mock recordings if schedule allows.

rows.title: Timed DSA (5-7 h/week when ready)
rows.description: Company-tagged practice only for genuine target roles. Two timed problems in a session can be enough; review mistakes.

rows.title: System design mocks (1-2/week; 2-3 stretch)
rows.description: Alternate classic backend design and bounded RAG/LLM integration. Record and review.

rows.title: Behavioral / STAR (2 short sessions/week)
rows.description: Rehearse out loud; concise 90-second stories with specific ownership and outcomes.

rows.title: Applications (6-10 targeted/week where role fit exists)
rows.description: Tailor to real requirements; quality over spray. Reduce volume in work/travel-heavy weeks.

rows.title: Referral asks (3-5/week where appropriate)
rows.description: Specific and respectful. No mass messaging or entitlement to a referral.

rows.title: Funnel review (30 min weekly)
rows.description: Track applications, screens, next stages, offers and recurring rejection patterns.

rows.title: Day 1: Confirm which DDIA edition you own from the title/copyright page
rows.description: Sets the DDIA edition in Settings; the default chapter map is the 2nd edition.

rows.title: Day 1: Install the current .NET LTS for the personal portfolio (.NET 10)
rows.description: Keep any employer-required target framework for work projects.

rows.title: Day 1: Create the C# DSA repository with a mistake-log file
rows.description: Start Arrays & Hashing with Contains Duplicate and Valid Anagram; attempt unaided for 25 minutes.

rows.title: Day 1: Read 7-10 DDIA pages
rows.description: Or less, if that allows a meaningful three- to five-line note.

rows.title: Day 1: Use Phase A from the Daily Operating Schedule
rows.description: Gym at 18:15 on training days and DSA after dinner; do not add a second daily timetable.

rows.title: Day 1: Open the tracker; distinguish full sessions from MVDs
rows.description: Use the Someday page (replaces someday-list.md) for new tools and course ideas.
